chat_history.content: Could you formulate a travel itinerary for me? I'm planning a solo trip from Dallas to Nebraska for 7 days, from March 7th to March 13th, 2022. During this trip, I wish to visit 3 different cities within Nebraska. My budget for this trip is $5,600.

content.content:
User wants travel itinerary: solo trip from Dallas to Nebraska for 7 days, March 7-13 2022. Visit 3 different cities within Nebraska. Budget $5600. Need to produce travel plan and save it using submit_day_plan function for each day (7 days). Must include fields: day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation. Also need to consider traveling from Dallas to Nebraska, then within Nebraska among three cities, then back? Probably 7 days includes travel days. Choose three Nebraskan cities, maybe Omaha, Lincoln, and Kearney or Grand Island. Provide plausible itinerary with meals, attractions.

We need to compute budget? Not required to output budget but should keep within. Provide reasonable cost.

We must call submit_day_plan for each day. Provide day 1 to 7.

We need to decide transportation: maybe flight from Dallas to Omaha, then car rental to travel between cities. Provide details.

Day 1: Travel from Dallas to Omaha (flight). Breakfast maybe at hotel in Dallas before leaving, but day current city after travel is Omaha. Transportation: flight details.

Breakfast maybe "The Original Pancake House, Dallas". Attraction in Omaha: "Henry Doorly Zoo, Omaha". Lunch: "Duncan's, Omaha". Dinner: "Block 16, Omaha". Accommodation: "Holiday Inn Express Omaha Downtown".

Day 2: Omaha: breakfast at "Stella's Cafe". Attractions: "Old Market, Omaha; Durham Museum, Omaha". Lunch "La Casa Pizzaria". Dinner "M's Pub". Accommodation same.

Day 3: Travel from Omaha to Lincoln (car). Transportation: "Rental Car: Toyota Camry, Omaha to Lincoln, 1h 15m". Breakfast maybe at "Knead & Brew, Omaha". Attraction: "Nebraska State Capitol, Lincoln; Sunken Gardens, Lincoln". Lunch "Dish, Lincoln". Dinner "The Oven, Lincoln". Accommodation "Lincoln Marriott Downtown".

Day 4: Lincoln: Breakfast at "The Bean Sprouts". Attractions: "University of Nebraska State Museum, Lincoln; Sheldon Museum of Art". Lunch "Chef's Bistro". Dinner "Alley Bar". Accommodation same.

Day 5: Travel from Lincoln to Kearney (car). Transportation: "Rental Car: Toyota Camry, Lincoln to Kearney, 2h". Breakfast at "Blackbird Coffee". Attraction: "Great Platte River Railroad Museum, Kearney; Fort Kearny State Historical Park". Lunch "Sagebrush Grill". Dinner "B&B Patio". Accommodation "Kearney Marriott".

Day 6: Kearney: Breakfast at "Mona Lisa Café". Attractions: "Museum of Nebraska Art, Kearney". Lunch "Miller's Bar". Dinner "The Junction". Accommodation same.

Day 7: Return to Dallas from Omaha (maybe drive back to Omaha then flight). So travel from Kearney to Omaha (car) then flight back. Or flight from Lincoln? Choose Kearney to Omaha then flight. Transportation: "Rental Car return, Kearney to Omaha, 1h 45m; Flight: Southwest Flight 3152, Omaha to Dallas, Departure 15:00, Arrival 17:30". Breakfast at Kearney: "Harvest Café". Lunch maybe at airport. Dinner maybe at home, so "-". Accommodation "-".

We must call submit_day_plan for each day. Provide day numbers 1-7.

Make sure to fill fields, using "-" where not applicable.

Proceed to call function for each day.

json_schema.description:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"

json_schema.title: submit_day_plan
